documents_scope_owner_check.name: documents_scope_owner_check
documents_scope_owner_check.value:
("documents"."scope_kind" = 'organization' AND "documents"."team_id" IS NULL AND "documents"."user_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("documents"."scope_kind" = 'team' AND "documents"."team_id" IS NOT NULL AND "documents"."user_id" IS NULL)
        OR ("documents"."scope_kind" = 'user' AND "documents"."team_id" IS NULL AND "documents"."user_id" IS NOT NULL)

knowledge_candidates_review_state_check.name: knowledge_candidates_review_state_check
knowledge_candidates_review_state_check.value:
("knowledge_candidates"."status" = 'pending' AND "knowledge_candidates"."reviewed_by" IS NULL AND "knowledge_candidates"."reviewed_at" IS NULL)
        OR ("knowledge_candidates"."status" IN ('accepted', 'rejected') AND "knowledge_candidates"."reviewed_by" IS NOT NULL AND "knowledge_candidates"."reviewed_at" IS NOT NULL)
